messages:
Ava: Quick idea — Tamales & Tabletop this Thursday? 6pm at the office kitchen or nearby cafe (weather permitting). Bring a favorite board game or we rotate. Vote with reactions: :one: Tamales at the kitchen (I can bring vegan filling) ; :two: Taco truck on 3rd St ; :three: Boardgame-only at office (snacks).
Marcus: I'm in for tamales! I can bring Catan and some extra napkins. :thumbsup:
Priya: Love tamales, thanks for offering vegan filling Ava — I'm vegetarian so that helps. Also any gluten-free options?
Devon: Could do tacos if we push to 6:30 — parking is rough earlier. If we stay 6pm I might be a few mins late.
Sofia: Boardgame-only works for me if we can stream one table for remote folks. I can bring a webcam and tripod. @Ava want me to set that up?
Ava: @Sofia yes please, that would be great. @Devon 6:30 is ok if most prefer — I'll tally votes and propose final time.
lunch-bot: Poll created — react to vote: :one: Tamales (office) ; :two: Taco truck ; :three: Boardgame-only. Current counts: :one: 2 ; :two: 1 ; :three: 1
Priya: Also two teammates are gluten-free — are tamales easily done GF?
Ava: Yep — I'll make some corn-husk tamales with masa harina that should be GF, and a vegan jackfruit option. Anyone allergic to corn please shout out.
Marcus: I'll bring extra cutlery, plates, and wipes. Devon can bring portable speaker if we want background music.
Devon: Speaker yes, I got a small bluetooth one. I can also grab some sodas on the way.
Sofia: I'll set up the laptop camera for remote participants and a small speaker check.
Ava: Provisional plan: Tamales at the office kitchen, Thursday 6:30pm. I'll create a calendar invite and note vegan/gluten-free options. Please RSVP with a 👍 if you're coming.
Marcus: 👍
Priya: 👍
Devon: 👍
Sofia: 👍
Ava: Sweet — tagging @everyone in the invite shortly. If anyone wants to bring a specific game drop it here (Catan, Sushi Go, The Crew, etc.).
